next_unit_hint: Before designing the tuned config: (1) set --mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer (hybrid GDN/SSM radix path) on the baseline and re-run the 64-token grid — no production recipe runs a hybrid model on a stock dense radix cache, so the current plateau may be an unsupported cache path, not a capacity limit; (2) do not hand-pick --mem-fraction-static near the computed floor (our 0.500 vs 0.4993) — use the default heuristic or a high value with available_gpu_mem verified in 5-8 GB; (3) reproduce in this order: Dynamo Qwen3.6-35B-A3B single-GPU SGLang flags (closest architecture match, has a published 90%-KV-reuse agentic trace and p50 TTFT), then SGLang HiCache collapsed to 1 GPU at --hicache-ratio 2 with the file backend, then the SGLang 4-arm HiCache ablation as the comparator; (4) keep page_size fixed across arms (production recipes pin 64, SGLang radix default is 1) or the comparison is confounded; (5) never run two cache owners at once (production-stack disables enablePrefixCaching when LMCache is on).
assumptions: The unit was run fully offline as instructed: local_web_search + local_web_crawl only; no live inference endpoint was contacted, so every number in the note is quoted from a primary source rather than re-measured.

'Production' was operationalised as: shipped as the vendor's/operator's reference deployment path (helm/kustomize/manifests) or backed by named production deployments or nightly E2E validation. A published benchmark recipe for a served configuration is recorded as 'benchmark-only' even when the surrounding stack is production.

GB10 (Grace Blackwell-class, single node) was treated as Blackwell-family for precision/backend transferability (NVFP4 weights, fp8_e4m3 KV, trtllm_mha) but the note flags attention/MoE backends as the hardware-specific part that may need substitution; this is an inference, not a measured result.
Where a blog had a performance section that this pass did not extract (vLLM tiered offloading 'Scaling to More Users'), the throughput claim is marked reported-only rather than quoted.

Tool-call accounting: 32 of the 45 allowed calls were used (4 misc filesystem, 4 searches, 24 crawls). Remaining budget was left unused deliberately once each of the six requested evidence areas had at least one primary source.
No files outside the three declared write paths were touched; docs/serving-options/ was created if missing and nothing else under docs/ was modified.
